svg.title: RaceDay Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Seven SQL Server entities with attributes, key types, relationships and cardinalities for RaceDay.
svg.text: Part 1 database model with SQL Server datatypes, keys and relationship cardinalities

g.text: PK = Primary key | FK = Foreign key | UQ = Unique | UQ* = Unique filtered index | NULL = Optional value
The EventCategoryId and EventId values in Enrolments form a composite foreign key to EventCategories.
The many-to-many activity between Participants and Events is resolved through Enrolments.

svg.text: Source: RaceDay Data Dictionary. Diagram prepared for the PROG6212 Part 1 Portfolio of Evidence.
